healthInsti.name: Southern Philippines Medical Center
healthInsti.description: The Southern Philippines Medical Center is the largest government hospital under the Department of Health of the Republic of the Philippines. It is located at the JP Laurel Ave, Bajada, Davao City. It began as the Davao Medical Center. Its name was changed on November 19, 2009, by Republic Act 9792.

branches.location: J.P. Laurel Ave, Bajada, Davao City

services.serviceName: Adult Cancer Clinic and Infusion Unit
services.serviceDescription: Opened on February 8, 2018 on the fourth floor of the Cancer Institute. It offers subsidized multidisciplinary care for all kinds of cancer. The hospital said most patients are free or subsidized charity, assisted through Lingap, PCSO and others.

healthInsti.name: Davao Doctors Hospital
healthInsti.description: Davao Doctors Hospital soon opened its doors to the public in 1969, starting with a 50-bed capacity. Over time, DDH continued to foster many other firsts in the region as its Radiation Oncology Department became fully operational, among other notable innovations.

branches.location: 118 E. Quirino Avenue, Davao City Philippines 8000

services.serviceDescription: The oncology Center uses clinical and holistic approaches for the management of cancer. We aim to cure- to eradicate the tumor and prevent its recurrence, as well as to relieve pain and other discomforts of cancer. Equipment: Dual Energy Linear Accelerator; the Elekta Synergy linear Accelerator- the first IMRT/IGRT facility. Services Offered: Radiation Consultation Evaluation; Treatment Planning; External Beam Radiography; Low Dose Rate (LDR) Brachytherapy; Blood Irradiation. Location: Ground Level, Oncology Building. Office Hours: 6:00am - 6:00pm. Contact: (082) 222 8000 local 8158 | radonco@ddh.com.ph

requirements.requirementDescription: Referral letter and a short clinical abstract.
Laboratory and Imaging work-ups with results and radiographs.
Complete blood count preferably normal or least 100 grams/dl. hemoglobin
Dental clearance for head and neck tumors.
Steroid coverage for brain and spinal cord irradiation.

services.serviceDescription: Curative: Destroy tumors that have not spread the other parts of the body and cure you of disease reduce the risk that cancer will return after you undergo surgery or systemic/chemotherapy by killing small amounts of remaining cancer cells shrink cancer before surgery. Palliative: Shrink tumors that are interfering with your quality of life, such as lung tumor that is causing shortness of breath to relieve pain by reducing the size of a tumor and other unpleasant symptoms, thus improving the quality of life and prolongation of survival. Radiation Therapy usually takes from a week to eight weeks, depending on the goal, either curative or palliative. It is given daily from Monday to Friday lasting only for a few minutes, based on the prescribed dose and number of treatment fields. Who can avail? It has clinical applications for patients diagnosed with malignant tumors and occasionally benign diseases. Location: Ground floor of Oncology Building. Contact: +63 82 222 8000 local 8158 | +63 82 222 7992 | radonco@ddh.com.ph
Brachytherapy is a procedure that involves placing radioactive material inside your body. Location: Ground Floor, Oncology Building. Office Hours: 24/7. Contact Info: 222-8000 local 7329.
